concrete_changes.before: **Structural mapping:** The ritual above operates on Kha-Ba-La architecture — **Kha** (the observer who notices time vanish), **Ba** (the body in Room 3, breath as count), **La** (the resistance of the clock, the friction of schedule, the gravity that makes presence feel like escape).
